manualFollowUps: Order: apply after the SAT Playbook public-modules migrations (20261026160000-20261026160999) so each premium guide links to its parent module via parent_page_id; if those are not applied yet, the guides still publish with module_key set and parent_page_id null.

Database: supabase db push --linked from an isolated copy of the installed migrations plus 20261026161000_sat_playbook_premium_guides.sql and 20261026161100_sat_playbook_plan_templates.sql, keeping any deliberately pending migrations (for example the #220 payment set) excluded. Dry run first, then supabase migration list --linked. Content-only: 6 premium guides (visibility premium, page_type guide) with 155 sections, 18 sources, 39 page-source citations, and 5 published plan templates. Idempotent (deterministic ids, on conflict do nothing); existing rows are never overwritten.

No frontend, edge function, worker or secret changes. The current sat-playbook PageBlocks renders the rich_text (markdown), checklist and callout block types used here; PlanPage renders schedule_json.phases and weeks[].label/focus, and the richer per-day fields (days[].tasks, hours, checkpoint) are available for the playbooks-engine renderer.
verification: supabase migration list --linked shows 20261026161000 and 20261026161100 applied.

GET /functions/v1/sat-playbook/catalog lists the 6 premium_guides (guide-rw-hard-module-traps, guide-math-hard-module-traps, guide-1200-to-1400-roadmap, guide-1400-to-1550-roadmap, guide-desmos-power-moves, guide-final-14-days).
GET /functions/v1/sat-playbook/pages/guide-final-14-days without a token returns 401/403 (premium); with a premium entitlement it returns 34 sections and 8 sources.
As a premium user, https://playbook.sat.schood.online/plans/four-week-sprint shows 4 phases and 4 weeks; the dashboard lists all 5 plan templates.

rollback.migration: Hide instead of deleting (recommendation snapshots may reference plan templates): update public.sat_playbook_pages set status = 'archived' where metadata->>'seeded_by' = '20261026161000_sat_playbook_premium_guides'; update public.sat_playbook_plan_templates set status = 'archived' where metadata->>'seeded_by' = '20261026161100_sat_playbook_plan_templates'. Sources can stay; they are only shown through published pages.
